dog.description_text: Luke is the sweetest boy and the biggest lover of pets! He is super chill and typically just lounges around, but has a silly side and will play around your apartment with any and all toys! He’s known for loafing on any surface and accepting any treats you send his way!! Takes a second to get cuddly, but he’s started to sleep on our beds and cuddle up when it’s TV time. Anyone who gets to love this boy will be the luckiest owner. Will be best in a single cat home. Apply for Luke today!
dog.name: Luke
